summary: Inspira Technologies OXY B.H.N. Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on April 28, 2026, furnishing a press release about receiving a fully paid $390,000 purchase order for an additive manufacturing electronics system from a premier APAC university. The order also establishes an ongoing recurring revenue stream from consumables and service fees. No terms such as stake size, price per share, premium, or any M&A or special-situation elements are present. The filing is a routine current report of a sales contract, not a special situation event. Inspira is the issuer of the Form 6-K.
